summary: OpenTelemetry, also known as OTel, is a vendor-neutral open source Observability framework for instrumenting, generating, collecting, and exporting telemetry data such as traces, metrics, and logs. As an industry-standard, OpenTelemetry is supported by more than 90 observability vendors, integrated by many libraries, services, and apps, and adopted by numerous end users.
